_doc: NONASK-1103 I-A6 D5 (A6-W): static labels and notes for vera/web_route.py, the inline answer-only web route. No new thresholds.
_fetch_cap_note: At most one fetch per host per call (one round). Further candidates on the same host are listed only, never fetched.
_crawl_delay_note: Robots Crawl-delay (VERA-DAR UA, else * group) is enforced in vera.public_fetch via a per-host in-process table (vera.selective_fetch.crawl_reserve); an early request is refused as crawl_delay and listed here (read_crawl_delay), never sent early.
_calibration_note: login_markers is an uncalibrated, discard-only heuristic (a hit drops the page text and lists the page; a miss changes nothing). marker_scan_chars bounds the scan; it is a safety bound, not a decision threshold. Accepted by the orchestrator 2026-11-04 as a CONSERVATIVE SKIP: measured on no real pages (synthetic fixtures only); false positives only drop a page to the reading list, false negatives are bounded by the read gate and public_fetch. Calibrate from owner-run dev traces (pages skipped as read_login_paywall vs. readable) before adding or removing markers.
_role_note: Role: pure and request-local. Reads only through vera.public_fetch after the READ gate. Page text is held in memory only; this module calls no store, cache, queue or logger with page text. Ingest is always False in this work package.
label: web source
disclosure: public web pages may be read to answer, and are stored only when their licence allows
login_markers: create a free account to continue

phrases.host_round_cap: not read: only one page per site is read per answer
phrases.fetch_failed: not read: the page could not be read
phrases.crawl_delay: not read yet: the site asks readers to wait between visits
phrases.empty: not read: the page had no readable text
phrases.ingest_answer_only: not stored: web pages are used for this answer only
